name: Multi-Step Pipeline Regression Debugging
description: Fix subtle boundary and empty-element bugs across ingest, transform, and sink stages.

inputs.task_prompt: The data processing pipeline in test/pipeline.test.ts is failing: 1) src/ingest.ts leaves empty trailing lines in tokens. 2) src/transform.ts drops records when key contains whitespace or is empty. 3) src/sink.ts omits totalCount if 0. Fix all 3 files so the entire end-to-end pipeline succeeds.

acceptance_criteria: src/ingest.ts trims lines and filters empty records
src/transform.ts safely trims and aggregates keys
src/sink.ts formats JSON summary preserving totalCount even when 0
